items.title: [Injury] Darryn Peterson crosses Jamir Watkins, who slips and tears his ACL, 102 seconds into a Summer League game. Watkins immediately clutched at his left knee, and shortly after, intentionally fouled Peterson in order to get subbed out. He was subbed back in 68 seconds later.
items.author: MrBuckBuck
items.body_excerpt: He played another 17:15 of the 19:57 total minutes he played in the game until the very end. Washington Wizards vs. Utah Jazz - Las Vegas Summer League - 7/9/26
